title: Baseline Fairness Plan
description: DESIGN-stage artifact. Output of baseline-fairness-planner. Declares the fairness check for baseline vs treatment comparison: matching data_hash, compute budget, and metric configuration. Any mismatch is listed in fairness_violations.

check_name.description: What is being compared, e.g. data_hash, compute_budget, metric_set

baseline_value.description: The baseline's value for this check (any JSON type)

treatment_values.description: Map of condition_id -> value for each treatment

fairness_violations.description: Human-readable descriptions of detected fairness mismatches. Empty = no violations found.

override_justification.description: If a known violation is intentional (e.g. budget mismatch is the studied variable), justify here
